title: Discover, describe and safely invoke project commands

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Build mcp-server and open the demo with bridge, verify and the Editor-only project-command fixture. Use one persistent MCP session. Preserve existing dirty scenes/settings and snapshot only disposable fixture files before mutation.

steps.title: Discover, describe and safely invoke project commands
steps.payload: List project.demo commands in one persistent MCP session. Describe project.demo.catalog_fixture and record assembly/type, schema_version, schema and response bytes. Invoke with labels:null and that version; reject limit:99 and unknown arguments. Describe long_write and verify its context parameter is absent and async/cancellable metadata present. Do not reconnect or refresh tools/list.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Read fixture succeeds; invalid arguments never reach user code.
Exact describe precedes invoke; record latency and call count against an explicit reflection/menu discovery baseline.

reset.note: Wait for terminal execution before restoring saved fixture bytes under Assets/_ValidationSuite/ProjectCommands. Preserve pre-existing files, scene changes and settings. Never restart an uncertain operation for cleanup.
